findings.problem: PoChangeRead.budget_effect is `list[dict[str, Any]]`, so the generated OpenAPI client has no type for the signed money delta. The two UI stories that render it each work around that differently: E13-S18 hand-writes `type Effect` and casts (`change.budget_effect as Effect[]`, apps/web/src/components/purchasing/changes/cards.tsx:6,24), E13-S19 stringifies every field (`String(e.delta)`, `String(e.currency)`, apps/web/src/components/purchasing/dialogs/CancelOrReduce.tsx:103). A hand-written response type is what AGENTS.md 3.4 forbids, and a server rename of `delta` or a change to its serialisation would pass tsc on both screens and render `undefined`/`NaN` as a budget figure.
findings.fix: Declare a `PoBudgetEffectRead` model (project_id, department_code, ledger_account_code, currency, delta: Decimal serialised as string) on PoChangeRead, regenerate the client, delete the local `Effect` type and the String() casts.
